diagnosed_problem: frontend makes a shipping quote gRPC call without a per‑call deadline; when shippingservice is partitioned the call hangs, causing Cart page timeouts and high error rates.

evidence.interpretation: Cart endpoint error rate spikes to 25 % during a shippingservice network partition because the GetQuote call hangs.

edits.original:
quote, err := pb.NewShippingServiceClient(fe.shippingSvcConn).GetQuote(ctx,
		&pb.GetQuoteRequest{
			Address: nil,
			Items:   items})
edits.replacement:
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	quote, err := pb.NewShippingServiceClient(fe.shippingSvcConn).GetQuote(ctx,
		&pb.GetQuoteRequest{
			Address: nil,
			Items:   items})
edits.purpose: Add a 2 s per‑call deadline to the shipping‑quote RPC so the frontend fails fast when shippingservice is unreachable, reducing latency and error‑rate spikes.

expected_benefit: Fast failure of the GetQuote RPC limits the duration of Cart page hangs, lowering the observed error‑rate max and p95 latency during shippingservice outages.
side_effects: When shippingservice is healthy the added 2 s timeout adds negligible overhead.
If shippingservice is slow but eventually returns, the request may now be cancelled early, causing the Cart page to return an error instead of a delayed response.
